fundamentals.name: United States Oil Fund, LP
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: USO seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in futures contracts for light, sweet crude oil, other types of crude oil, diesel-heating oil, gasoline, natural gas, and other petroleum-based fuels.

judgment.summary: USO is an oil ETF, not a company with traditional fundamentals, and its price is driven by commodity markets.
positives: Recent surge in crude oil prices provides tailwinds.
negatives: As an ETF tracking oil futures, it is subject to extreme volatility and contango/backwardation effects.
Trailing P/E of 40.64 is not directly comparable to equity P/E ratios and reflects commodity price movements.
